issue.body:
I have a package called `views` inside which I have separated modules for each resource, for example, I have a module called `users.py` which imports the `app` instance from top-level package and using `@app.route("/{some_variable}")` decorator I have a `class User(HTTPEndpoint)`

I am also importing the module into my `app.py` but the route doesn't seem to be registered. Am I missing something?

```
.
├── app.py
└── views
    ├── __init__.py
    └── users.py
```
issue.title: How to add routes from modules?
